author: BoldAndBrash
body:
Just a small thing I thought of that you, the community, may like. Basically, we could have Kylo Jav and Pav become Senior Devs, and then have other people who are willing to do some small developing like bug fixes, making mini plugins, etc. This could help a LOT on efficiency which is the main reason I think this would be great. 


Senior Devs: Kylo, Pav, and Jav. These guys can work on small things, but they also do the work on major updates.

Devs: Basically any staff who can do a decent job at doing developing. They work on smaller things like website fixes, anti cheat, etc. If they do really good. The senior Devs can decide whether or not to make the person a senior dev or let thm stay as a dev or be demoted. Picking Devs could be a hand picking thing.
